_comment: Competitors are NEVER treated as customers. Matches here go in the Competitors section of the briefing as intel. Corrected Nov 2, 2026 (Mark; audited against library '08 — Competitors & Market Comparisons' + web sources). Three battlegrounds: electric, electrohydraulic, gearboxes. STRUCK from the old list: DeZURIK, Henry Pratt (valve-OEM customers), Scallon Controls (Emerson distributor), BAFCO (AUMA's own line), ProMation (private-label partner).

competitors.name: Rotork
competitors.note: Electric: IQ range — the #1 rival. Also electrohydraulic.

competitors.name: ABB
competitors.note: Electric: acquiring Rotork (agreed Jul 16, 2026 — 506p/share, GBP 4.14 bn, completion expected H1 2027). ABB pairs Rotork IQ with its control systems/software. Added Nov 5, 2026 from FMI sample report.

competitors.name: Emerson
competitors.note: Electric: Bettis (XTE3000, RTS), EIM electric lines, Biffi.

competitors.name: Flowserve Limitorque
competitors.note: Electric: Limitorque MX; deep refinery/pipeline installed base.

competitors.name: Bernard Controls
competitors.note: Electric: INTELLI+; strong in water and industrial.

competitors.name: SIPOS
competitors.note: Electric: German precision actuators; on internal comparison sheet.

competitors.name: Asian imports
competitors.note: Electric: grouped watch item — I-Tork, HKC, Greatork.

competitors.name: Belimo
competitors.note: Electric: HVAC damper/valve actuators; data center cooling focus — opened Data Center Experience Center, Danbury CT, Nov 3, 2026. Added Nov 5, 2026.

competitors.name: SAMBO Gears
competitors.note: Gearboxes: Busan, Korea; master distributor Mechanical Advantage Corp (Houston/The Woodlands TX); Limitorque private-labels Sambo gears.
